answer: TideRidge Desk's practical sybil defense is to make each identity its own costly island. A newcomer locks a distinct stake and must complete a spiral of independently graded original work before gaining any vote or grading seat. Extra names therefore require extra stakes and extra attested histories. Near-duplicate answers slash both stakes. The network then issues a non-transferable violet receipt to the identity that did the work, so one prompt cannot be ferried across a flock without paying the full cost again.
